_comment: Copy to data/placeholders.json to override the built-in list.
These are categories a sync assigns by default rather than because you
chose them. While a transaction is still unreviewed, sitting in one of
these counts as uncategorized and `lmbot categorize` will fill it in.
Once you review a transaction, it is left alone regardless.
Run `lmbot categories --usage` to see which categories your own unreviewed
transactions actually land in, then list the import defaults here.
Entries match a category name, a "Group > Name" path, or a numeric id.
Naming a group covers every category inside it.
